gloss: to jostle; to be packed together

definitions.gloss: to jostle; to be packed together; to crowd together
definitions.explanation: Of many people or things, to be crowded tightly into one place, pressing against one another. Used of crowds, buildings and shops, and figuratively of rivals competing in a small field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひしめき{合|あ}う。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひしめき{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Shops are packed together in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {初売|はつう}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、{開店前|かいてんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひしめき{合|あ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: On the morning of the New Year sale, customers were jostling at the entrance before the store opened.

notes:
⟦ひしめく→ひしめく：07834_hishimeku⟧ (to throng) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (each other); usually written in kana. Mostly used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form to describe a scene. The figurative use for rivals crowded into one market or league is common in news writing: ⟦{強豪|きょうごう}→強豪：31606_kyougou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひしめき{合|あ}う⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧ (a league packed with strong teams).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひしめき{合|あ}う: people jostle
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひしめき{合|あ}う: shops crowd together
- ひしめき{合|あ}う⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧: a jostling crowd
- ⟦{強豪|きょうごう}→強豪：31606_kyougou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひしめき{合|あ}う: strong rivals compete side by side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {混|こ}み{合|あ}う: to be crowded — a place is full; less sense of bodies pressing together
